note: City holiday pages (QUEUE G16 step 4, OWNER D32). One record per event, read on the page named. An event leaves after end_on. Dollar text lives only in cost_*, *_priced and extra fields, which hide once the read is older than 30 days. No year in the URL: refreshed each season.

news.name: Vessel holiday lighting
news.text: second annual ceremony, Nov 16, free, with Anthony Ramos headlining.

news.name: Macy's parade
news.text: the 100th, Nov 26, with a record 100 inflatables, per NYC Tourism.

picks.label: Kids under 6
picks.why: Model trains in a conservatory, with more outdoors, and you can go by day.

picks.label: Ages 4 and 8 together
picks.why: With the 2-in-1 ticket, daytime animals from 1 p.m., then the lights, so each age gets something.

picks.label: Keeping tickets at zero
picks.why: No ticket is listed for the tree. The rink is free only with your own skates.

picks.label: Cold or wet day
picks.why: The conservatory trains are indoors, with more outdoors. The show is indoors.

picks.label: Free for under-3s
picks.why: Lightscape lists ages 0 to 2 free; the zoo, 2 and under.

picks.label: Sensory needs
picks.why: The dates are on the card.

items.text: Gingerbread NYC, Museum of the City of New York: opens Nov 6
Harlem Holiday Lights, West 125th Street: Nov 17
Origami Holiday Tree, American Museum of Natural History: opens Nov 23
The Nutcracker, New York City Ballet: Nov 27 to Jan 3, sensory-friendly show Jan 3
Winter Village Metropolis, Children's Museum of Manhattan: Dec 8 to 31
Holiday markets: Union Square, Columbus Circle, Grand Central Holiday Fair

events.name: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
events.place: Central Park West at W 77th St to Herald Square, Manhattan
events.cost_note: Free to watch, per NYC Tourism.
kids: The 100th parade, with a record 100 inflatables
events.watch: NYC Tourism's page lists no start time or viewing spots. Check Macy's own page for both before you plan the morning.

events.name: Vessel holiday lighting
events.cost_note: The ceremony is free and open to the public.
kids: Live show with Anthony Ramos and a drumline
events.extra: The inside holiday display is $10 a ticket, 7 to 9 p.m.
events.watch: It's on a school night. The page doesn't say whether display tickets need buying ahead.
events.extra_stale: The inside holiday display has its own ticket; check live.

events.name: Bryant Park ice rink
events.dates: Now to Feb 28, 2027, weather permitting; 8 a.m. to midnight Nov 19 to Jan 3
events.cost_note: Free with your own skates and a reserved ticket.

kids.text: Skate aids for small kids, $26, free before 10:30 a.m. if available
kids.stale: Skate aids for small kids; check the price and the early-morning offer

kids: Free helmets; kids' skates from size 6T
Stroller parking from mid-November, first come
Own-skates tickets must be reserved, and are released a week ahead
events.extra: Skate aids $26, socks or a lock $6.24 each, bag check $6.24 an item.
events.watch: Under-14s need an adult, and you can't carry a child while skating. There's no re-entry.
events.cost_priced: Rentals run $18.72 to $64.48 each, fee included, cheaper off-peak.
events.extra_stale: Skate aids, socks, locks and bag check; check live.
events.watch_priced: A non-skating adult gets in free per two kids under 14; extras cost $11.29.

events.name: Rockefeller Center tree
events.dates: Lights on Dec 2; up to Jan 9, per news reports
events.cost_note: None of the pages we read lists a ticket to see the tree. NYC Tourism only says December for the lighting.

kids.text: Time Out says the lighting-night crowd is an attraction in itself

kids: In Midtown, like Radio City and Bryant Park
events.extra: We could not read prices for the rink by the tree.
events.watch: The Dec 2 lighting comes from NY1 and Time Out, and the Jan 9 end from NY1. Check Rockefeller Center's own page for visiting hours.

events.name: Lightscape
events.cost_note: The page doesn't say which nights are which: the ticket calendar will.
kids: A trail of light displays, with wheelchair-accessible paths
No strobes, but some flashing lights

kids.text: Sensory-friendly early entry at 4 p.m., Dec 3 and Dec 18
Skip Dec 10 and Dec 17: both are 21+ nights

events.watch: Earplugs are available at the box office. Trail length and stroller rules aren't on the page.
events.cost_priced: Fees included. Adult $29 Value nights, $39 off-peak, $44 peak; child 3-11 $15, $22, $28; age 0-2 free.

events.name: Bronx Zoo Holiday Lights
events.cost_note: We did not see whether tax or fees are added.
kids: Arrive from 1 p.m. with the 2-in-1 ticket to see animals by day; check your ticket type includes it
New this year: the Children's Zoo Farmyard opens for the lights

kids.text: Sensory Inclusive Night on Dec 3, reserve ahead

events.extra: Holiday Train $4 a ride; car parking $22.
events.watch: It runs rain or shine. The calendar on the ticket page shows which nights are open. Stroller rules aren't on the pages we read.
events.cost_priced: Dated tickets: adult $29.95 or $37.95, child 3-12 $14.95 or $22.95, age 2 and under free. An any-night ticket is ≈ $142 for 4.
events.extra_stale: Holiday Train and parking; check live.

events.name: NYBG Holiday Train Show
events.dates: Nov 14, 2026 to Jan 10, 2027; open to 8 p.m. on select evenings
events.cost_note: NYBG's show page says the All-Garden Pass includes the show. We did not see whether tax or fees are added.
kids: Model trains inside a glass conservatory, more outdoors

kids.text: Sensory-friendly mornings: Nov 21 and Jan 9, 9 to 11 a.m., with music off

kids: Allow about 3 hours, per NYBG's guide from last season
events.extra: Parking was $22 last season, first come.
events.watch: Last season NYBG called weekdays the quietest and Dec 20 to Jan 3 the busiest, with timed entry by day. Check whether that holds this year.
events.cost_basis: All-Garden Pass, no year stated; the show price may differ
events.cost_priced: Adult $35 weekday, $39 weekend; child $15, $17; under 2 free. The admission page states no year and no child age. Last season's show tickets charged kids $25-$27, so check your date.
events.table_cost_note: All-Garden Pass; show price may differ

events.name: Christmas Spectacular
events.place: Radio City Music Hall, Midtown Manhattan
events.cost_note: The official pages we read show no prices; they send you to the ticket calendar.
kids: Under 2 sits on a lap with no ticket
Free stroller check; free sensory bags with headphones, ID needed
events.extra: Ticket prices weren't on the pages we read; check fees at checkout.
events.watch: It has sudden loud noises, flashing lights, smoke, confetti and pyrotechnics, so think about that for little ones. No minimum age is listed.

new-york-city.hero_alt: The Rockefeller Center Christmas tree at night, seen down a snowy promenade lined with lit angels and snow-covered shrubs
new-york-city.hero_place: Rockefeller Center in December 2020, an older photo, not this season.
